subscribe.honestTitle: What this is, and what it is not
subscribe.honestModel: Alerts fire on our estimate for your point, not on an official CPCB reading of that exact spot.
subscribe.honestWindow: The CPCB bands are defined on 24-hour averages. We compare them against an hourly estimate, so an alert is a heads-up, not an official classification.
subscribe.honestPrivacy: Your address is stored only to send these alerts, and every email contains a one-click unsubscribe.
subscribe.honestRate: At most one email per crossing. There is no daily summary.

crosscheck.title: Independent check
crosscheck.explainer: Two different measurements of the same air. Ours is anchored to the nearest CPCB monitor, so it can catch a pocket of pollution a regional grid smooths away; CAMS is a satellite-and-model average over tens of kilometres. A gap is normal — a large one usually means your street is dirtier than the regional average, not that the number is wrong.
crosscheck.notAReading: This is a model, not a monitor at your address.
crosscheck.unavailable: No independent reading available right now.
crosscheck.dustNote: Delhi's dust season is strong right now, so the aerosol reading includes dust — it is not fire smoke.
